# MagniData

> MagniData is Precision AI's open-source (Apache-2.0) explorer for image datasets. It extracts per-image quality,
> complexity and coverage metrics into a CSV, and serves them with a Flask API and a React dashboard for browsing
> images and segmentation masks, filtering by metric, and viewing embeddings in 3D (PCA, t-SNE, clusters). It can
> also train segmentation models and turn per-image losses into dataset axes.

- Live read-only demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/precisionaiinc/magnidata
- Demo HTTP API, no authentication: https://precisionaiinc-magnidata.hf.space/api (try `/api/datasets`)
- Source: https://github.com/Precision-AI-Inc/magnidata
- Not on PyPI yet. Install the wheel attached to the latest GitHub Release
  (https://github.com/Precision-AI-Inc/magnidata/releases), or run the full stack with `docker compose up`.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Precision-AI-Inc/magnidata/main/README.md): what MagniData is, the quickstart, and the section "Use it from a script or an agent", with the HTTP API's read endpoints and curl examples
- [Data contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Precision-AI-Inc/magnidata/main/precisionai/magnidata/docs/data-contract.md): the CSV and embeddings JSON formats the dashboard and API read
- [Feature extractor and embeddings CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Precision-AI-Inc/magnidata/main/precisionai/magnidata/tools/README.md): every metric column and flag
- [Recipe: from images to dashboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Precision-AI-Inc/magnidata/main/precisionai/magnidata/docs/recipes/from-images-to-dashboard.md): turn a folder of images into a dataset the dashboard can open
- [Recipe: training feedback loop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Precision-AI-Inc/magnidata/main/precisionai/magnidata/docs/recipes/training-feedback-loop.md): train, find the hard images, curate, train again
